description: This file contains functions related to success policy handling for Kubernetes jobs, including matching success policies, checking success criteria conditions, and rules for succeeded indexes.

methods.name: matchSuccessPolicy
methods.description: Determines if a success policy matches based on rules and succeeded indexes.

methods.name: hasSuccessCriteriaMetCondition
methods.description: Checks if the success criteria condition for a job is met.

methods.name: isSuccessCriteriaMetCondition
methods.description: Checks if a specific job condition indicates success criteria are met.

methods.name: matchSucceededIndexesRule
methods.description: Checks if succeeded indexes match a rule's indexes and count.
